listing.name: The Ur-Quan Masters
listing.summary: Explore the original Star Control II campaign in The Ur-Quan Masters with the project's base game data.
listing.download_block_reason: Use the publisher's setup or your Linux package manager. The release bundles game content under separate terms and installation stays with the upstream installer or package manager.

steps.title: Install the Windows release
steps.instruction: Download uqm-0.8-win32.exe from the publisher and run the installer. Keep the base game content selected and use the installed shortcut to play. The installer and player are 32-bit and require Windows support for 32-bit applications.

steps.title: Install from your Linux distribution
steps.instruction: On Debian or Ubuntu, install uqm with your package manager and let it install the required uqm-content package. Start The Ur-Quan Masters from the app menu or run uqm. Ubuntu 26.04 publishes x86-64 and ARM64 packages. Other distribution packages are linked on the project's download page.

steps.title: Install the Intel Mac app
steps.instruction: Open uqm-0.8-macos.dmg and copy The Ur-Quan Masters.app to Applications. The Intel app includes the base game content. The publisher documents where to add the optional voice and 3DO music packages inside the app bundle.

steps.title: Back up your profile
steps.instruction: Close the game and copy %APPDATA%/uqm on Windows or ~/.uqm on Linux and macOS. Keep the save and teams subdirectories and the settings files. Copy any add-ons you placed in the installation separately before replacing the package.

warnings: Keep the stock profile separate from MegaMod profiles and use the matching base data and add-ons.

references.title: Check platform availability
references.instruction: The 0.8.0 Mac download contains an Intel executable. The publisher offers no native Apple Silicon app or Android APK in this release. The project links separately maintained ports.
